*.text: North Dakota context. Amalia Llano is editing North Dakota this week and is the reviewer of this batch. Her values are the baseline: report a change to one of her values only when a verified source disagrees with it, and re-verify her value with a source she has not cited otherwise. Read the harvested permit index in scopes/us-nd/work/permits/<plant id>.md and the commission cases and queue entries on this brief first. The regulator is the North Dakota Public Service Commission (cases numbered like PU-25-086; documents at https://www.psc.nd.gov/webdocs/case/YY-NNNN/). Air permits come from the Department of Environmental Quality, Division of Air Quality (notices under https://deq.nd.gov/AQ/Notices/). Most of the state is in the Southwest Power Pool; the eastern edge (Cass and Grand Forks counties) is in the Midcontinent Independent System Operator. Fill Equipment Manufacturer/Model on every unit where a permit, filing or company page names the turbine or engine make and model (checklist row 15). Fill Latest Activity on every unit in development when the newest dated report is over a year old. The December rule applies: a unit in development whose scheduled start falls in 2026 with no source confirming it gets a new scheduled event with 2027 as Event Year and 2026 as Source Year.

L100001047848.text: Bison Generation Station. Southwest Power Pool requests GEN-2024-081 and GEN-2024-082 (Basin Electric, 760 MW nameplate each, 2028 and 2029, Springbrook to Tande 345 kV) look like units 1 and 2: confirm from the queue CSV and cite the queue as a Latest Activity or Start year source where it helps. Read commission case PU-25-086 (the certificate of site compatibility) and the November 2025 Division of Air Quality notice of intent in the BasinElectricBison notice folder for the turbine make and model, the capacity per block and the construction start. EIA-860M plant 69071 shows the four generators as regulatory approvals pending, not under construction, while GEM says construction: settle the status with two independent publishers (a Basin Electric groundbreaking release, the commission order, news). Capacity: GEM has 745 MW per block, EIA has 759 MW per block (263 plus 496), the queue 760 MW. Report the nameplate the best document gives.

L100001080387.text: River Run Energy Center. Southwest Power Pool requests ERAS-2025-011 and ERAS-2025-012 (Stanton, 750 MW each, agreement pending, in service 2029-09-27, Leland Olds substation) look like this plant: 1,500 MW against GEM's 1,450 MW in one unit. Settle the capacity from the best document (a NextEra or Basin Electric release, a commission filing, the air notice) and say whether the queue's two 750 MW requests mean two combined cycle blocks. If a document shows two blocks, stage a question on the unit split rather than splitting the unit yourself. The Status Detail says early siting as of April 2026: find anything newer (a letter of intent or siting application at the commission, an air permit application). Check the start year against the queue's 2029 date.

L100000401741.text: Pioneer generating station. The EIP Oil and Gas Watch sheet says Pioneer unit 1 is under construction while GEM says operating: settle it with the EIA-860M operating sheet and Basin Electric's page. Pioneer phase IV: Southwest Power Pool requests GEN-2022-083, GEN-2022-010 and GEN-2022-009 (Judson 345 kV) are phase IV; check the start years of 4-1, 4-2 and 4-3 (2025) against EIA-860M and the commission cases PU-22-380, PU-14-829 and PU-12-509. Fill the turbine and engine make and model and the engine count for 4-2 and IC from the permits.

L100000401740.text: Lonesome Creek Station. Southwest Power Pool request GEN-2020-014 (Alexander, 45 MW) is likely unit 6 or an uprate: confirm. Check the unit count against EIA-860M plant 57943 and the manual's rule for aeroderivative gas turbine sets (each unit is a turbine with Number Of Engines and Capacity Per Engine filled for an aeroderivative set). Fill the turbine make and model from the permits.

L100000104092.text: Heskett Station. Unit 4 started in 2024 at Mandan (Montana-Dakota Utilities): confirm with EIA-860M plant 2790 and commission cases PU-25-280 and PU-24-365 (generation cost recovery) and PU-11-631 (the 88 MW turbine of unit 3). The validation report's two Heskett items (Owner 1 has no source; unit 4 links to a replacement unit that does not exist) must each be answered, tagged check 7. Montana-Dakota Utilities' 2024 North Dakota integrated resource plan volume IV is on the US IRPs tab: check whether it plans any further gas at Heskett.

L100000104096.text: Spiritwood Industrial Park (Great River Energy, Jamestown). The validation report's three Spiritwood items (Owner 1 has no source; Location has no source; the carbon capture field on G100001017988 has no source) must each be answered, tagged check 7. Commission case PU-25-263 (DSA Capture Company, Spiritwood Energy Park) is the likely carbon capture source. The county is blank: it is Stutsman County. Check EIA-860M plant 56786 for status and capacity and whether the plant still burns gas or coal.

L100001083334.text: Polaris Forge 1 power station (Ellendale, Dickey County). The county is typed Dikey County; the right spelling is Dickey County. The Sierra Club list's Applied Digital Natural Gas Plant units 1 to 4 of 300 MW are matched to this plant by name only: decide from documents whether those four 300 MW units are Polaris Forge 1 and 2 or Base Electron at Center, and say so in a question. Compare the 400 MW steam unit with the Applied Digital and Babcock and Wilcox announcements and commission cases PU-24-359, PU-24-330 and PU-26-173. Check the owner (Babcock and Wilcox and Minnkota, 50 percent each) against a document.

L100001083335.text: Polaris Forge 2 power station (Harwood, Cass County). Minnkota's Agassiz line case PU-26-022 serves the Harwood campus at 280 MW. Check the 280 MW steam unit, the owner and the start year against the newest documents, and whether the county field follows the convention of the other rows. Settle the Sierra Club Applied Digital Natural Gas Plant question together with Polaris Forge 1 and Base Electron.

L100001089074.text: Applied Digital ELN Generation Plant (Ellendale). These are backup engine fleets at the Polaris Forge 1 campus. Compare the engine counts and megawatts of ELN02, ELN03-CAT, ELN03-MTU and ELN04 with the newest Division of Air Quality permits and notices (AppliedDigital notice folder, May 2026 letter and notice) and commission case PU-26-155 (the April 2026 jurisdictional determination on backup generation). Fill Number Of Engines, Capacity Per Engine and the engine make and model.

L100001089073.text: Applied Digital FAR Generation Plant (Harwood). Backup engine fleets at the Polaris Forge 2 campus. Compare FAR01 and FAR02 (288 MW each, 3 MW engines) with the newest Division of Air Quality permits and notices and commission case PU-26-155. Fill Number Of Engines, Capacity Per Engine and the engine make and model.

L100001089055.text: Base Electron power station (Center, Oliver County). Four 300 MW units with Babcock and Wilcox boilers and Siemens steam turbines for a data center campus. Read Montana-Dakota Utilities cases PU-26-219 and PU-26-236 (APLD BIS-01 at Center) and the Babcock and Wilcox and sec.gov sources. Settle whether the Sierra Club's Applied Digital Natural Gas Plant units 1 to 4 of 300 MW are this plant. Fill start years only when a document gives them.

L100001084854.text: Nakota Data Center Campus Power Plant (Williston). Three units of 338 MW with 16.9 MW engines; unit 1 pre-construction for 2027, units 2 and 3 announced. Check the engine count per unit and the phases against the newest documents (air permit application, company releases, commission filings), and fill Number Of Engines, Capacity Per Engine and the engine make and model.

L100001089086.text: Minnkota Power Cass power station. Amalia Llano added this plant on 2026-10-29 from the North Dakota Monitor report of 2026-10-06 (https://northdakotamonitor.com/2026/10/06/minnkota-plans-gas-fired-power-plant-in-cass-county-adding-to-energy-development/): a 400 MW gas turbine plant in Harmony Township north of Mapleton, about one billion dollars, 2031 to 2032, dependent on the Bakken East pipeline. Find Minnkota's own release or a commission filing (letter of intent, ten-year plan PU-26-254) as a second publisher, the turbine type, and a site description for the location.

L100000407864.text: Xcel Fargo power plant: cancelled 2022. It stays cancelled unless a document revives it. MISO request J3163 (Northern States Power, Cass County, 481 MW hybrid with a simple cycle combustion turbine, in service 2028-03-30, point of interconnection Bison substation) is a separate new project unless a document ties it to this one: say which in a question.
